name: Kunima Kanae
source:
She is a nun at the local church, St. Mary's. She has a calm demeanor and a soft smile, and is kind to all people regardless of their background. 

As a nun, she has taken a vow of celibacy for the rest of her life, but perhaps as a reaction to this, she loves to talk about love, and when she hears about the troubles of a young girl in love, she is more than willing to help her, she even willing to offer herself to men caught up in lust.

She is a good person, but her perception of sex is fatally off, and she is a naturally immoral whorish nun. It seems that she just barely keeps her chastity and exclusively uses her asshole.
